subject: Dynamic indexing found in a vector of indices, 1:L.

messages.author: 389ddf164df09cc1
messages.subject: Dynamic indexing found in a vector of indices, 1:L.
parts:
I am working with a very simple BYM model shown below:

code <- nimbleCode(
  {for(i in 1:N){
    y.i[i] ~ dpois(omega.i[i])
    log(omega.i[i]) <- log_prop_global +phi.i[i]
   
  }
    # ICAR
     phi.i[1:N] ~ dcar_normal(adj[1:L], weights[1:L], num[1:N], tau = 1, zero_mean = 1) # its scaled so tau = 1
 }
)

The spatial components for phi.i are created using sample BYM code available from this website, ie the adj, weights, etc. 

However, I continue to get the same message no matter what I try (shown below). Could this be a problem with my shape file and how it is translated using the poly2nb function?

Defining model
Error in getSymbolicParentNodesRecurse(x, constNames, indexNames, nimbleFunctionNames,  :
  Dynamic indexing found in a vector of indices, 1:L. Only scalar indices, such as 'idx' in 'x[idx]', can be dynamic. One can instead use dynamic indexing in a vector of indices inside a nimbleFunction.

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Dynamic indexing found in a vector of indices, 1:L.
parts:
For those interested, it looks like (from off-list follow-up) this was resolved by providing L and N as constants.  When provided as data, nimble thinks the values might change, and it has to treat them differently (dynamic, aka stochastic, indexing), and that was the root of the error.  Thanks for posting the issue!
Perry
